objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: maayos na follow-up.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: following up constructively.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ihiwalay ang alam sa hindi pa nakukumpirma.
sections.takeaway_en: Separate known facts from what is unconfirmed.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sabihin ang pakay, itanong ang status at linawin ang susunod na hakbang.
sections.takeaway_en: State your purpose, ask about status and clarify the next step.

sections.takeaway_fil: Card B ay nagtatanong; hindi nito ginagawang fact ang hula.
sections.takeaway_en: Card B asks; it does not turn a guess into a fact.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ulitin ang naunawaan at itanong ang hindi pa malinaw.
sections.takeaway_en: Repeat what you understood and ask about what remains unclear.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tiyakin ang contact at napagkasunduan; huwag mag-imbento ng deadline.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm the contact and arrangement; do not invent a deadline.

sections.takeaway_fil: Alam · tiyak na tanong · paglilinaw · angkop na susunod na hakbang.
sections.takeaway_en: Facts · specific question · clarification · appropriate next step.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang maayos na follow-up sa kasong ito?
check.prompt_en: What is a constructive follow-up in this case?

options.fil: Itanong ang pagtanggap at status sa tamang contact; makinig, linawin ang sagot at magkasundo sa susunod na hakbang.
options.en: Ask the appropriate contact about receipt and status; listen, clarify the response and agree on the next step.

options.fil: Sabihing aprubado na dahil matagal nang naghihintay.
options.en: Declare approval because the wait has been long.

options.fil: Ipagpalagay na nawala ang dokumento at ipasa muli lahat nang hindi nagtatanong.
options.en: Assume a document was lost and resubmit everything without asking.

check.feedback_fil: Una: tama. Hindi pa tiyak ang pagtanggap at status, kaya nagtatanong at nakikinig muna; ang susunod na hakbang ay dapat linawin sa tamang contact. Ikalawa: walang batayan. Hindi patunay ng approval ang tagal ng paghihintay. Ikatlo: hula ang sanhi at requirement. Linawin muna kung may item na kailangang tiyakin at ang tamang paraan; huwag ipasa muli lahat batay sa hula.
check.feedback_en: First: correct. Receipt and status remain unconfirmed, so ask and listen first; clarify the next step with the appropriate contact. Second: unsupported. A long wait does not prove approval. Third: it guesses the cause and requirement. First clarify whether an item needs verification and the proper method; do not resubmit everything based on a guess.
